# FinanceGigs

> FinanceGigs is an opt-in candidate pool of finance and accounting professionals, matched to the roles we sync from employers' own career sites.

## Hiring data
- [Finance Hiring Trends](https://financegigs.ai/hiring-trends): the latest month of U.S. finance hiring data from employers' own career sites: open roles by level, remote share, posted pay, skills, certifications and where the jobs are. Updated monthly.
- [Hiring Trends archive](https://financegigs.ai/hiring-trends/archive): every past month, each at its own address.

## Members and employers
- [Join free](https://app.financegigs.ai/join): roles matched to your profile, by text and email.
- [Use FinanceGigs from an AI assistant](https://app.financegigs.ai/ai): our MCP connector, for searching the roles we're actively matching and reading market data.
- [For employers](https://financegigs.ai/employers)
